answer: Require each agent to post a refundable identity bond before it can trade. Like rain dissolving karst into hidden caves, a sybil attacker hides armies of fakes underground, but every fake must lock its own collateral, and peer auditors that expose a forgery burn that bond and collapse its nadir network of clones. Honest agents reclaim their bond plus fees and sign each deal with a single quill-key tied to their history, so an attacker pays per fake while an honest agent pays once.
